scope: Complete general-family reconstructed 76-point cohort; not full live QVT
decision_cutoff: Date-based after signal-session closing evidence; exact historical quote release time unavailable
financial_knowledge_cutoff: Asia/Tehran signal-day midnight; publication strictly before cutoff; includes known missing/rejected report metadata
execution: First global traded session strictly after signal; exact positive-volume gate

execution_stress.scope: Conservative sensitivity scenarios; daily bar limits do not certify queue priority; residual orders expire at rebalance

buffer_variant: Retain existing eligible members while rank <= 15; refill by current rank; no lookahead
reference: MATCHED_EQUAL_WEIGHT; same complete cohort and execution dates
validation: Fixed-model chronological evaluation on previously observed history; no untouched holdout claim

uncertainty.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of daily returns

research_acceptance.note: Research screening thresholds preregistered before this run; not the user's real account risk budget. Passing does not authorize promotion.
